chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Hadeed, who said:

'Ali ibn Muyassar wrote to him, asking him about a man who performed 'Umra during the month of Ramadan, then the season (for Hajj) presented itself to him. Should he perform Hajj exclusively (Ifrad) for Hajj, or should he perform Tamattu'? Which of the two is superior? So he wrote to him: 'Performing Tamattu' is superior.'
ai.seo_question: Which is superior: Hajj al-Ifrad or Hajj al-Tamattu' for one who performs 'Umra in Ramadan?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Ali ibn Musayyir queries Ahmad ibn Muhammad regarding the superior form of Hajj for one who performs 'Umra in Ramadan and then stays for the Hajj season. The response affirms that Hajj al-Tamattu' is preferred over Hajj al-Ifrad in this scenario, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on the merit of combining the two pilgrimages with a distinct interval. This ruling highlights the flexibility within Shia fiqh to prioritize spiritual benefit and ritual completeness over strict adherence to the Prophet's initial practice of Ifrad.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Hadeed who said,

‘Ali Bin Muyassar wrote to himasws, asking himasws about a man who performed Umra during the Month of Ramazaan. Then the season (for the Hajj) presented itself to him. Should he go exclusively for the Hajj, or should he perform Tamatto, which of these two is superior?’ So heasws wrote to him: ‘Performing Tamatto which is superior’.
en.sarwar: 7. Certain persons of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from ibn abu Najran from Safwan al-Jammal who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of certain people who say that one must perform al-Hajj alone, others say to make it Qiran and drive the offering animal, and still others say to take advantage between al-‘Umrah and al-Hajj.
He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, said, ‘If I will perform al-Hajj for a thousand years I will not make it Qiran. I will only perform advantageous al- Hajj (al-Hajj al-Tamattu‘ ).’”
